articles.title: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion
articles.snippet: The trader turned $300 into over $200,000 as early footage of GTA 6 sent degens flocking between different token tickers.

articles.title: Scattered Spider Hacker Sentenced to 6 Years Over $11.6M in Stolen Crypto
articles.snippet: Scotland's Tyler Buchanan is the last of five defendants sentenced in a phishing and SIM-swapping scheme that targeted crypto holders.

articles.title: Judge Acquits MIT Brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV Case, Ending Prosecution
articles.snippet: A federal judge ruled prosecutors failed to prove the material misrepresentation needed for wire fraud, a year after a jury deadlocked.
